articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Feb. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the acceptance of two abstracts from studies on its lead candidate bezisterim (NE3107), in the treatment of Alzheimer’s Disease and Long COVID at the 2026 American College of Psychiatrists (ACP) annual meeting, to be held February 18-22, in Bonita Springs, FL. The two abstracts have been accepted for presentation as posters during a session to be held on February 18, 2026.
